items.exampleEn: Losing a game can have a psychological effect on young players.
items.exampleZh: 輸球可能會對年輕球員造成心理影響。

items.exampleEn: He could not hide his anger.
The children's whispers stopped when the teacher came in.
items.exampleZh: 老師一進來，孩子們的低語聲就停了。

items.exampleEn: Waiting for the test results filled her with anxiety.
items.exampleZh: 等待考試結果讓她非常焦慮。

items.exampleEn: That dog can be aggressive, so don't touch it.
items.exampleZh: 那隻狗可能有攻擊性，所以別摸牠。
items.glossZh: 有攻擊性的；積極進取的

items.exampleEn: Please give me your honest opinion.
items.exampleZh: 請告訴我你真實的意見。

items.exampleEn: We heard a loud yell from the playground.
items.exampleZh: 我們聽到遊樂場傳來一聲大叫。

items.exampleEn: Personally, I prefer tea to coffee.
items.exampleZh: 就我個人而言，我比較喜歡茶。

items.sentenceEn: The manager came personally to say sorry to us.
items.sentenceZh: 經理親自來向我們道歉。

items.audioEn: Be honest with me. Did you break the window?
items.audioZh: 老實告訴我，是你打破窗戶的嗎？

items.sentenceEn: She took a deep breath to control her anger.
items.sentenceZh: 她深吸一口氣，控制住自己的怒氣。

items.sentenceEn: Some shop assistants are too aggressive, and customers don't like it.
items.sentenceZh: 有些店員太過咄咄逼人，顧客不喜歡。

items.stemEn: From the next room, I heard a ____, so I knew they were telling secrets.
items.stemZh: 我聽到隔壁房間有人在低聲說話，就知道他們在說祕密。

items.stemEn: Thank you for being ____ with me; I needed to hear the truth.
items.stemZh: 謝謝你對我坦白，我需要聽到實話。

items.passageEn: When my son started at a new school, he felt a lot of anxiety. One day, he suddenly came home with anger in his eyes. A bigger boy had been aggressive and pushed him. I decided to speak personally with his teacher. She was very honest: she had not seen it happen. The next day, she talked to both boys. Later, my son told me in a whisper that he felt safer now. The teacher said the psychological side of a new school is often harder than the lessons. Now the only yell I hear from him is a happy one when he sees his friends.
items.passageZh: 我兒子剛轉到新學校時非常焦慮。有一天，他突然帶著滿眼怒氣回家。一個比較高大的男孩對他很兇，還推了他。我決定親自去找他的老師談。老師很坦白：她當時沒看到。隔天，她和兩個男孩都談了話。後來，兒子小聲地告訴我，他現在覺得比較安全了。老師說，換新學校的心理層面往往比課業更難。現在我從他那裡聽到的叫聲，只剩下見到朋友時開心的大叫。

questions.questionZh: 兒子為什麼帶著怒氣回家？

options: 打電話給那個男孩的父母

items.promptZh: 就我個人而言，我覺得這個計畫很好。
referenceEn: Personally, I think this plan is very good.
Personally, I feel that the plan is great.
rubricZh: personally 放句首時加逗號，表示「就我個人而言」
後面接自己的看法，主詞用 I
可用 I think…、I feel… 等

items.promptZh: 那個男孩很誠實，把撿到的錢包交給了警察。
referenceEn: The boy was honest and gave the wallet he found to the police.
The honest boy took the wallet he found to the police.
rubricZh: 用 honest 表示「誠實的」（例如 was honest、the honest boy 等）
「撿到的錢包」可寫，例如 the wallet he found 等；時態可用 gave、has given 等
